answer: A registered identity must post a bond escrowed under a hardware-bound credential and stake a work-proof beacon that independent jurors can recheck. Forging one identity locks 500 units for 20 epochs, and a proven challenge slashes 90 percent of the bond. Splitting yields no discount: each fake identity pays the full 500-unit bond, and one shared harbor of slashed funds plus juror review of the quill-signed proof removes the gain.
